notes.title: Animal Across: Afrika 2.0
notes.notes:
Animal Across: Afrika completed 1 year of release on the 10th and we are bringing a major update to the game's visuals for all our players.

We wanted to make the game more beautiful and sought to improve the look of each scene. Now you have brighter colors and more beautiful scenes to admire while having fun alone or with a friend playing Animal Across: Afrika.

notes.title: Achievements
notes.notes:
Achievements are now available in Animal Across: Afrika. At first we added 94 achievements, but we want to add even more. But for that to happen, we need to show Steam that we have an engaged audience.

Check out the game and achievements at and have fun.
